title: user.merged
description: A guest account was folded into an existing one on sign-in (stapel-auth 0.30.0): from_user_id ceased to exist and its rows belong to into_user_id. The opposite instruction to user.deleted, which anonymizes the same columns — stapel-docs re-parents them instead: Document.owner, Folder.created_by, Revision.created_by, DocumentUpdate.author_id and UploadSession.created_by. Idempotent: a redelivery finds nothing left under the guest.
